Paste a normal Google Sheets share link or a direct CSV export link. Google Sheets Sync - Stock Finder

Paste a normal Google Sheets share link or a direct CSV export link. Keep the columns in this order: Company name, ISIN, BSE Symbol, NSE Symbol, MSEI Symbol, the three 6-month average market caps, Average of All Exchanges, and Categorization.
